faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything about your order in one place — tracking, payments, shipping, returns, and how to reach a human when you need one.
faq.stillBody: Could not find your answer? Reach support directly, or read how returns and exchanges work step by step.

items.q: Where do I find my Order ID?
items.a: Open Account → Orders. Every order card shows the Order ID at the top with its display number underneath. The details page repeats it right under the confirmation message, next to a QR code you can scan to reopen the same order.

items.q: What do the order statuses mean?
items.a: Preparing means we are getting your parts ready, Packed means the parcel is handed over to the courier, Shipped means it is on its way with a courier, and Delivered means it arrived. Payment has its own status next to it: Awaiting payment, Authorized, or Paid.

items.q: My tracking (AWB) number is not showing. Why?
items.a: Tracking numbers are booked manually with the courier after handoff, so there can be a short delay between the Shipped status and the AWB appearing. If it still has not shown up, send us your Order ID on WhatsApp and we will look it up.

items.q: Do I need an account to buy?
items.a: Yes — prices and checkout are for members. Create an account, verify your email through the link we send you, then sign in. Guests can still browse the full catalog, search parts, and read datasheets.

items.q: My order is under a different email. Where is it?
items.a: Scroll to the order transfer form at the bottom of the Orders page and paste the Order ID from your confirmation. That links the order to your account so you can follow it there.
Checkout supports QRIS, GoPay, and bank transfer through Midtrans. Your order is confirmed once the payment is captured — the order page shows the live status.

items.q: What is the difference between Authorized and Paid?
items.a: Authorized means your payment method approved the amount but the money has not been captured yet. Paid (captured) means the payment landed and your order moves to preparation.

items.q: My payment is stuck on Awaiting payment. What should I do?
items.a: Finish the payment in your e-wallet or banking app first — pending Midtrans transactions expire automatically. If you already paid but the status did not move, contact support with your Order ID and payment proof.

items.q: Which couriers do you use, and what does it cost?
items.a: Courier options and costs are calculated at checkout from the parcel weight and your destination, with J&T Express and JNE among the available services.

items.q: Can I change the shipping address after ordering?
items.a: Only before the order is packed. Contact support immediately with your Order ID — once the parcel is handed to the courier the address can no longer be changed.

items.q: How do I request a return or exchange?
items.a: Reach support by WhatsApp, phone, email, or by visiting the store, with your Order ID, the item(s), the reason, and photos of the item and packaging. Every case is tracked in our system from request to refund or replacement.

items.q: What if my item arrived damaged or wrong?
items.a: Keep all packaging and take unboxing photos, then report it right away. Damaged and wrong-item cases are filed as claims so we can prioritize a refund or a replacement shipment.
Once the returned item is received and checked, the refund goes back to the original payment method you used at checkout.

items.q: How do I find the right part number?
items.a: Search the catalog by part number or specification — many listings include datasheets. If you are unsure, send us the markings on the old part or the appliance model on WhatsApp and we will help you match it.

items.q: An item I need is out of stock. Can you get it?
items.a: Often yes. Ask support with the exact part number and quantity — we source components regularly and can tell you the lead time.

items.q: Do you have a physical store?
items.a: Yes — visit us at {address}. For directions, use the Maps link in the footer or on the contact page.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.subtitle: Changed your mind, received the wrong part, or got a damaged item? Every request is handled as a tracked case in our system — refund, replacement, or claim — and reviewed by the support team. You will need your Order ID to start.

steps.title: 1. Send a request
steps.body: Reach support through any channel below with your Order ID, the item(s) you want to return or exchange, the reason, and photos of the item and packaging.

steps.title: 2. Review & approval
steps.body: Our team reviews every request against the order record and confirms whether it is approved, along with the return shipping instructions.

steps.title: 3. Ship the item back
steps.body: Pack the item safely and send it to the address support gives you. Keep the courier receipt until the case is closed.

steps.title: 4. Resolution
steps.body: Once the returned item is received and checked, we issue a refund to your original payment method or ship your replacement.

conditions: Items should be unused and in their original packaging, unless they arrived damaged or different from what you ordered.
Report damaged, defective, or wrong items as soon as possible after delivery, with unboxing photos.
Refunds go back to the original payment method used at checkout.
Shipping fees for approved returns are confirmed case by case with support.
